# awscc_agentregistry_registry (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::AgentRegistry::Registry



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `approval_configuration` (Attributes) Configuration for the registry's record approval workflow. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--approval_configuration))
- `authorizer_type` (String) The type of authorizer that controls how consumers access the registry's search and MCP invoke operations.
- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the registry was created.
- `description` (String) The description of the registry.
- `discovery_configuration` (Attributes) Discovery configuration for the registry. Controls how consumers are authorized to search the registry and invoke its MCP endpoint. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--discovery_configuration))
- `name` (String) The name of the registry.
- `registry_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the registry.
- `registry_id` (String) The unique identifier of the registry.
- `status` (String) The status of the registry.
- `tags` (Attributes List) Tags to assign to the registry. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `updated_at` (String) The timestamp when the registry was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--approval_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `approval_configuration`

Read-Only:

- `auto_approval_rules` (List of String) The rules that determine which registry records are automatically approved on submission. When omitted or empty, submitted records require manual review.


<a id="nestedatt--discovery_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `discovery_configuration`

Read-Only:

- `authorizer_configuration` (Attributes) The authorizer configuration for the registry. This is a union - specify exactly one member. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--discovery_configuration--authorizer_configuration))

<a id="nestedatt--discovery_configuration--authorizer_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `discovery_configuration.authorizer_configuration`

Read-Only:

- `custom_jwt_authorizer` (Attributes) Configuration for a custom JWT authorizer that validates inbound bearer tokens against an OpenID Connect identity provider. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--discovery_configuration--authorizer_configuration--custom_jwt_authorizer))

<a id="nestedatt--discovery_configuration--authorizer_configuration--custom_jwt_authorizer"></a>
### Nested Schema for `discovery_configuration.authorizer_configuration.custom_jwt_authorizer`

Read-Only:

- `allowed_audience` (List of String) The audience values accepted during JWT validation.
- `allowed_clients` (List of String) The client identifiers accepted during JWT validation.
- `allowed_scopes` (List of String) The scopes accepted during JWT validation.
- `custom_claims` (Attributes List) Additional custom claim validations applied to the inbound JWT. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--discovery_configuration--authorizer_configuration--custom_jwt_authorizer--custom_claims))
- `discovery_url` (String) The OpenID Connect discovery URL used to retrieve the identity provider's metadata and signing keys.

<a id="nestedatt--discovery_configuration--authorizer_configuration--custom_jwt_authorizer--custom_claims"></a>
### Nested Schema for `discovery_configuration.authorizer_configuration.custom_jwt_authorizer.custom_claims`

- `inbound_token_claim_name` (String)
